items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: I know her. She worked at Tomath with me, too.

ctx.x: She told me a lady she studied with, because they used to play duets together. A lady teacher. A lady teacher, yeah.
I know her. She worked at Tomath with me, too. She was with you, too. Yeah, she worked at... She lived at Covington. She lived about 30 miles from there.
